graph_self_description.description: MediaPipe graph to detect/predict hand landmarks on CPU.

nodes.name: GateCalculator
nodes.description: When the optional input side packet "use_prev_landmarks" is either absent or set to true, uses the landmarks on the previous image to help localize landmarks on the current image.

nodes.name: NormalizedRectVectorHasMinSizeCalculator
nodes.description: Determines if an input vector of NormalizedRect has a size greater than or equal to the globally defined num_hands.

nodes.name: GateCalculator
nodes.description: Drops the incoming image if enough hands have already been identified from the previous image. Otherwise, passes the incoming image through to trigger a new round of palm detection.

nodes.name: PalmDetectionCpu
nodes.description: Detects palms.

graph_self_description.description: MediaPipe graph to detect palms with TensorFlow Lite on CPU.

nodes.name: ImageToTensorCalculator
nodes.description: Transforms an image into a 128x128 tensor while keeping the aspect ratio, and therefore may result in potential letterboxing.

nodes.name: TfLiteCustomOpResolverCalculator
nodes.description: Generates a single side packet containing a TensorFlow Lite op resolver that supports custom ops needed by the model used in this graph.

nodes.name: SsdAnchorsCalculator
nodes.description: Generates a single side packet containing a vector of SSD anchors based on the specification in the options.

nodes.name: TensorsToDetectionsCalculator
nodes.description: Decodes the detection tensors generated by the TensorFlow Lite model, based on the SSD anchors and the specification in the options, into a vector of detections. Each detection describes a detected object.

nodes.name: NonMaxSuppressionCalculator
nodes.description: Performs non-max suppression to remove excessive detections.

nodes.name: DetectionLetterboxRemovalCalculator
nodes.description: Adjusts detection locations (already normalized to [0.f, 1.f]) on the letterboxed image (after image transformation with the FIT scale mode) to the corresponding locations on the same image with the letterbox removed (the input image to the graph before image transformation).

nodes.name: ClipDetectionVectorSizeCalculator
nodes.description: Makes sure there are no more detections than the provided num_hands.

nodes.name: ImagePropertiesCalculator
nodes.description: Extracts image size.

nodes.name: BeginLoopDetectionCalculator
nodes.description: Outputs each element of palm_detections at a fake timestamp for the rest of the graph to process. Clones the image size packet for each palm_detection at the fake timestamp. At the end of the loop, outputs the BATCH_END timestamp for downstream calculators to inform them that all elements in the vector have been processed.

nodes.name: PalmDetectionDetectionToRoi
nodes.description: Calculates region of interest (ROI) based on the specified palm.

graph_self_description.description: MediaPipe subgraph that calculates hand ROI from palm detection.

nodes.name: DetectionsToRectsCalculator
nodes.description: Converts results of palm detection into a rectangle (normalized by image size) that encloses the palm and is rotated such that the line connecting center of the wrist and MCP of the middle finger is aligned with the Y-axis of the rectangle.

nodes.name: RectTransformationCalculator
nodes.description: Expands and shifts the rectangle that contains the palm so that it's likely to cover the entire hand.

nodes.name: EndLoopNormalizedRectCalculator
nodes.description: Collects a NormalizedRect for each hand into a vector. Upon receiving the BATCH_END timestamp, outputs the vector of NormalizedRect at the BATCH_END timestamp.

nodes.name: AssociationNormRectCalculator
nodes.description: Performs association between NormalizedRect vector elements from previous image and rects based on palm detections from the current image. This calculator ensures that the output hand_rects vector doesn't contain overlapping regions based on the specified min_similarity_threshold.

nodes.name: ImagePropertiesCalculator
nodes.description: Extracts image size.

nodes.name: BeginLoopNormalizedRectCalculator
nodes.description: Outputs each element of hand_rects at a fake timestamp for the rest of the graph to process. Clones image and image size packets for each single_hand_rect at the fake timestamp. At the end of the loop, outputs the BATCH_END timestamp for downstream calculators to inform them that all elements in the vector have been processed.

nodes.name: HandLandmarkCpu
nodes.description: Detect hand landmarks for the specific hand rect.

graph_self_description.description: MediaPipe graph to detect/predict hand landmarks on CPU.

nodes.name: ImageToTensorCalculator
nodes.description: Transforms a region of image into a 224x224 tensor while keeping the aspect ratio, and therefore may result in potential letterboxing.

nodes.name: SplitTensorVectorCalculator
nodes.description: Splits a vector of tensors to multiple vectors according to the ranges specified in option.

nodes.name: TensorsToFloatsCalculator
nodes.description: Converts the hand-flag tensor into a float that represents the confidence score of hand presence.

nodes.name: ThresholdingCalculator
nodes.description: Applies a threshold to the confidence score to determine whether a hand is present.

nodes.name: GateCalculator
nodes.description: Drops handedness tensor if hand is not present.

nodes.name: TensorsToClassificationCalculator
nodes.description: Converts the handedness tensor into a float that represents the classification score of handedness.

nodes.name: GateCalculator
nodes.description: Drops landmarks tensors if hand is not present.

nodes.name: TensorsToLandmarksCalculator
nodes.description: Decodes the landmark tensors into a list of landmarks, where the landmark coordinates are normalized by the size of the input image to the model.

nodes.name: LandmarkLetterboxRemovalCalculator
nodes.description: Adjusts landmarks (already normalized to [0.f, 1.f]) on the letterboxed hand image (after image transformation with the FIT scale mode) to the corresponding locations on the same image with the letterbox removed (hand image before image transformation).

nodes.name: LandmarkProjectionCalculator
nodes.description: Projects the landmarks from the cropped hand image to the corresponding locations on the full image before cropping (input to the graph).
nodes.warning: *️this calculator is defined in the source tree by C++ code (not in a pipeline's .pbtxt definition file) per pipeline each defined by the C++ api call graph.AddNode("'LandmarkProjectionCalculator'"). the current source association of it is hard-wired and not auto-discovered.

nodes.name: GateCalculator
nodes.description: Drops world landmarks tensors if hand is not present.

nodes.name: TensorsToLandmarksCalculator
nodes.description: Decodes the landmark tensors into a list of landmarks, where the landmark coordinates are normalized by the size of the input image to the model.

nodes.name: WorldLandmarkProjectionCalculator
nodes.description: Projects the world landmarks from the cropped hand image to the corresponding locations on the full image before cropping (input to the graph).
nodes.warning: *️this calculator is defined in the source tree by C++ code (not in a pipeline's .pbtxt definition file) per pipeline each defined by the C++ api call graph.AddNode("'WorldLandmarkProjectionCalculator'") the current source association of it is hard-wired and not auto-discovered.

nodes.name: EndLoopClassificationListCalculator
nodes.description: Collects the handedness for each single hand into a vector. Upon receiving the BATCH_END timestamp, outputs a vector of ClassificationList at the BATCH_END timestamp.

nodes.name: HandLandmarkLandmarksToRoi
nodes.description: Calculate region of interest (ROI) based on detected hand landmarks to reuse on the subsequent runs of the graph.

graph_self_description.description: MediaPipe graph to calculate hand region of interest (ROI) from landmarks

nodes.name: HandLandmarksToRectCalculator
nodes.description: Converts the hand landmarks into a rectangle (normalized by image size) that encloses the hand.

nodes.name: RectTransformationCalculator
nodes.description: Expands the hand rectangle so that the box contains the entire hand and it's big enough so that it's likely to still contain the hand even with some motion in the next video frame .

nodes.name: EndLoopNormalizedLandmarkListVectorCalculator
nodes.description: Collects a set of landmarks for each hand into a vector. Upon receiving the BATCH_END timestamp, outputs the vector of landmarks at the BATCH_END timestamp.

nodes.name: EndLoopLandmarkListVectorCalculator
nodes.description: Collects a set of world landmarks for each hand into a vector. Upon receiving the BATCH_END timestamp, outputs the vector of landmarks at the BATCH_END timestamp.

nodes.name: EndLoopNormalizedRectCalculator
nodes.description: Collects a NormalizedRect for each hand into a vector. Upon receiving the BATCH_END timestamp, outputs the vector of NormalizedRect at the BATCH_END timestamp.

nodes.name: PreviousLoopbackCalculator
nodes.description: Caches hand rects calculated from landmarks, and upon the arrival of the next input image, sends out the cached rects with timestamps replaced by that of the input image, essentially generating a packet that carries the previous hand rects. Note that upon the arrival of the very first input image, a timestamp bound update occurs to jump start the feedback loop.
